item.title: WATCH- “Nahi jitega to bandook tumhari taraf”- Shastri’s message to Gambhir; says communication and man-management skills crucial
item.description: Former India coach Ravi Shastri has spoken on the broader view of accountability amidst the Indian team’s ongoing poor performance in red-ball cricket under the guidance of Gautam Gambhir. Though India has won the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 and Asia Cup 2025 under Gambhir, the focus has been on the Test series losses to New Zealand and South Africa at home, who whitewashed India in India, and the 3-1 series loss in Australia. item.title: “Concerned about character assassination”- R Ashwin on unfair criticism of individuals after Gambhir, Rana targetted by fans
item.description: Former India spinner R Ashwin has spoken about unfair criticism by fans and critics of individuals. Gambhir found himself in a predicament last month, when India suffered their second home Test series whitewash in a row, both during his time as coach. item.description: Indian team head coach Gautam Gambhir has explained why the team management has been backing young Harshit Rana in the white-ball formats. Constant encouragement from management has sparked controversy among cricket analysts, but despite the outside noise, the 23-year-old continues to work on his game. item.title: “Both of them have to prove is itself a laughable”- R Ashwin on Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli's careers example for next gen players
item.description: Former India cricketer R Ashwin has shared his thoughts on Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma’s recent performances for the Indian team and also stated that the two legends do not need to prove themselves to anyone. item.title: IND v SA 2025: ‘Abhishek Sharma is a big wicket for us’- Aiden Markram calls India opener a ‘match-winner’ before 1st T20I
item.description: South Africa T20I captain Adien Markram has revealed that his team feels that India batter Abhishek Sharma will be the big wicket for the Proteas.
